opening.argument: The evidence presents a branded, karaoke-style Coinbase commercial rather than a concrete solicitation to participate. The description identifies the material as a commercial and uses crypto-related promotional framing, while the visible frames show the Coinbase name and lyric-style text. Its financial-app messaging asks whether it is the only app needed and whether it is secure, but those claims are not accompanied by a promised return, required payment, credential request, or other participation flow. The description further limits the message by stating that it is for informational purposes and is not investment advice. Given that the full spoken and visual context is only partly observable, the available evidence supports ordinary commercial promotion without establishing a deceptive transaction or other concrete scam mechanism.
